suspects.description: Raw hex address 0x1d182f0 assigned to bare local `pCVar3`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `pCVar3` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.

Pointer cast of byte-offset arithmetic reaching a struct member via an array-indexed element + sibling field + offset (e.g. `(CMirror *)(p[1].create_event + 0x1c)` -> `&this->mirror`). Replace with the named field/array access in a .keep.

Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCVar5` self-updates via pointer arithmetic on its own `actor_name` field (which decays to a pointer), `+ CONST`; `offsetof(actor_name) + CONST*sizeof(elem)` equals the stride of a *different* array the loop reads through `pCVar5`. Replace those `pCVar5->other_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update. (String/buffer-copy cursors that only touch the advanced field are excluded here — those are unrolled_strcpy/unrolled_memcpy.)
